description: Check a Cruise Planner(크루즈 플래너) trip plan that the traveler shared with you. Input the share token or the full share link (…/trip/s/<token>), or the plan_ref of a plan made with plan_cruise_trip. Returns which stages are filled (cruise, brief, flights, hotels, port days), whether the plan is complete, and links to the shared plan and its PDF. Flight and hotel stages: open = not started yet; pending = not decided yet, the planner is still searching; chosen = in the plan; self_booked = the traveler booked it; undecided = left for later or none found, the plan works without it and it can be added in the planner; not_on_sale = flights for these dates are not on sale yet; declined = the traveler said it is not needed; not_needed = not applicable. Plans of signed-in members are private: only their existence and the link are returned. ui_language describes the shared-page UI requested by user_language. plan_language is the stored language of the plan content and its PDF.

plan_ref.description: plan_ref from plan_cruise_trip, instead of share_token. Returns stage progress only; plan_cruise_trip returns the links.

share_token.description: Share token (24 characters) or the full share link. Required unless plan_ref is given.

user_language.description: The traveler's language as a BCP 47 tag (e.g. "en", "ja", "ko", "zh-TW"). Korean (ko or ko-*) or a missing value opens Korean UI; English (en or en-*) and any other language or invalid tag opens English UI. Valid tags are used for anonymous usage statistics and preserved as a language hint in a chosen-cruise start link. It does not translate narrative answers or saved plan content. The returned ui_language reports the language actually used.

name: get_plan_status
title: Status of a shared Cruise Planner plan
